claims.claim: CAM NarrowPhaseDetector tests only vertices and centroid against cylinders, omitting triangle edges and face penetration.
claims.implementationEvidence: Section 1 explicitly defines pointsToCheck = [tri.v0, tri.v1, tri.v2, centroid]. Section 2 performs 5 discrete linear steps along zone segments calling closestPointOnTriangle, but does not perform exact continuous cylinder-triangle intersection.
claims.notes: Section 2 provides 5-step point sampling along the tool axis, but rapid tool orientation changes or obstacles between sample points can tunnel.

claims.claim: FiveAxisCollisionEngine completely ignores obstacle triangular faces, testing only vertex coordinates.
claims.implementationEvidence: Loops exclusively with 'for (const v of obstacle.vertices)' against cap.p0 and cap.p1. obstacle.faces is unreferenced.
claims.notes: Tools plunging through face interior without touching corner vertices report zero collision.

claims.claim: Kinematic clearance engines use hardcoded Math.max(0.1, centerDist - 30.0) without CAD geometry.
claims.implementationEvidence: Direct arithmetic subtraction of 30.0mm constant from Euclidean center distance.
claims.notes: Hardcoded 15mm radius sphere assumption per body.

claims.claim: CollisionDetectionWorkspace.tsx executes on synthetic demo test fixtures rather than active CAD document geometry.
claims.implementationEvidence: Explicitly invokes CollisionDetectionEngine.createSampleObstacleTriangles(activeBenchmark.id) which constructs 2-6 hardcoded triangles.
claims.notes: No production callpath exists from the active CAD document to CollisionDetectionWorkspace.

claims.claim: AssemblyInterferenceEngine fails open on OCCT boolean errors, returning false NO_INTERFERENCE.
claims.implementationEvidence: try/catch block swallows kernel exceptions, sets intersectSolid to null, logs console.warn, and defaults status to 'NO_INTERFERENCE'.
claims.notes: Catastrophic geometry failure is indistinguishable from clearance.

claims.claim: ContinuousCollisionDetector is discrete multi-step sampling (4 to 25 sub-steps), not analytical continuous collision.
claims.implementationEvidence: Calculates numSubSteps = Math.max(4, Math.min(25, ...)) and evaluates discrete poses poseAtT.
claims.notes: Thin wall tunneling is possible between sub-steps.
